title: Absolute and Adverbial Clause Constructions
summary: Verbless or participial absolute phrases describing subject states in formal Persian.
explanation: Formal Persian uses verbless parenthetical phrases to describe simultaneous states (e.g., کتاب در دست = book in hand).

example_translations.ex_abs_1: Ali entered the room, book in hand.

common_error_explanations.err_abs_1: Omit explicit verbs in formal literary absolute phrases.
